n8n_templates.title: RSS to daily digest email
n8n_templates.summary: Once a day (default 07:00 in the n8n instance timezone, set here to Europe/Lisbon), the workflow reads an RSS feed, builds an HTML list of up to 20 items, and emails the digest.

n8n_templates.title: Form to Google Sheet and notification
n8n_templates.summary: An n8n form collects Name, Email and Message. Each submission is appended to a Google Sheet, then a notification email is sent.

n8n_templates.title: Website uptime check to alert
n8n_templates.summary: Every 5 minutes the workflow requests a URL. If the HTTP status is not 200, or no status is returned (timeout or network error), it waits 60 seconds and requests the URL again. An alert email is sent only if the second check also fails. A successful 200 on either check does not send mail.
